guide.title: Welcome
guide.text: Welcome to Oikome. It keeps your photos, notes and tables on your own computer, in collections, and nowhere else unless you share them.

guide.title: The examples
guide.text: Everything you see now is an example, kept as plain files in the Examples folder where your data lives. Edit a note, a CSV file or a photo's caption with any app, and Oikome reads the change within a minute. Photos and notes are read where they are; Sources shows where each table comes from.

guide.title: New collections
guide.text: New Collection makes one of your own. Choose where it is stored: Local, a folder, a NAS or a cloud drive. Settings → Storage picks where new ones go.

guide.title: Sharing
guide.text: To share a collection, add the person as a contact with their ID, then press Share. You choose whether they view it live or keep a copy, and until when; they get an invite code to open it.

guide.title: Stopping and Activity
guide.text: Stop Sharing takes effect at once: their next read is turned away. Activity shows every read and every refusal, and it is kept only on this computer.

guide.title: Recovery key
guide.text: Back up your recovery key. It is your identity: with it, this data center can be brought back on a new computer, and no one else has a copy.

guide.title: Shortcuts
guide.text: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows and Linux) to jump to a collection, a person or a page, or to switch between the Ink and Bold styles.
